missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs for /v1/authorizations
Order service logs/metrics showing where its 2s timeout is spent
candidates.statement: Gateway checkout POSTs return 502 after ~2s because the gateway's client call to order (/v1/orders) hits a transport ReadTimeout at ~2s; order in turn times out calling payment (/v1/authorizations), while inventory/redis reservations succeed. The latency originates downstream of the gateway, in the order->payment path.
candidates.uncertainty: Evidence is gateway-side only; no payment or order service telemetry to confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s driven by a ~2s transport ReadTimeout on gateway->order, and order->payment ReadTimeout, while inventory/redis succeed. This bounds the fault to the order->payment downstream path; payment-side telemetry is needed to pin the exact cause.
